newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close 1.26 percent lower.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close 1.26 percent lower.

text.p: French shares closed 1.26 percent lower on profit-taking after an overnight fall on Wall Street was taken by investors as a signal that a the romp ahead from the start of the year could be coming to an end, dealers said.
But French stocks, which were retracing from a record close on Thursday, did not extend their losses much further in the afternoon, when Wall Street made fresh declines.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 30.91 points or 1.26 percent at 2,430.34 while the CAC-40 futures contract was down 35 points at 2,429. This week the CAC-40 gained 0.21 percent. Volume on Friday was 9.58 billion francs.
Paribas was 2.14 percent down at 369.90 francs after insurer AXA said it had sold 2.42 percent in the bank at 1.1 billion francs.

Other financials were mainly stronger after rises which pulled the market upwards on Wednesday and Thursday. Cie Bancaire was up 2.85 percent at 686 francs, BNP down 0.18 percent at 226 francs and CCF up 0.86 percent at 257 and Societe Generale jumped 4.73 percent at 620 francs.
Biggest faller was Eramet, down 7.62 percent to 291 on a newspaper report its chairman was set to quit.
